name: smwgraphics-mario-s-time-machine-nes-styled-mario
title: Mario's Time Machine! (NES) Styled Mario
description:
Ever wanted to use the Mario from Mario's Time Machine! (NES)?
Well, if yes, then you are in luck!

This Mario fits perfectly in 8-bit hacks, and goes well with NES tilesets.

Be aware tho! This graphic uses the 32x32 Player Patch!

Also, if you plan to use Cape Mario, insert GFX32 as well, which fixes some stuff with the Cape.
